name: ANSI/IEEE electrolytic capacitor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for electrolytic capacitor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The electrolytic capacitor form adds a documented construction or polarity qualifier to the capacitive function. The actual component determines whether polarity marking is required; this original preview illustrates a polarised use rather than declaring every electrolytic type identical.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Check component polarity and allowed voltage before following the DC connection.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Electrolytic construction is different from simply rotating a generic capacitor graphic.
